name: Ring of Deep Diving
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 2nd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of swimming and functions as such. In bodies of water 50 feet deep or deeper, the wearer must make a DC 15 Will save or be compelled to dive to the bottom. The wearer must make this save every round she remains in water 50 feet deep or deeper.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. In this event, the ring may be removed but the ring and enchantment remain intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of swimming

Identification DC 27
False Identification DC 17
